summary: The all-occurrence dyadic bins cover every positive endpoint and give the stated strict singleton, paired-mass, and matching-mass bounds. The ancestry comparison, synchronization estimate, Hall bound, max-flow construction, whole-label deletion, and pair-preserving recoupling are valid, including the 93/97 retained and 4/97 complementary constants.
